resources.string: Detects which app is on screen so the limits set by the parent can be applied. Screen content is only read on Android\'s security and permission pages, while uninstall protection is on, so the app cannot be switched off without the parent. In browsers, scrolls are counted, without reading the pages, to tell reading from quick scrolling.
Prevents uninstalling Family Screen Time without the parent.
This Family Screen Time setting needs the parent code. Open the app and switch to parent mode to change it.
Only the parent should turn this protection off, from parent mode in Family Screen Time.
Family Screen Time no longer sees apps
Android stopped its detection service. A parent should turn it off and on again: Settings, Accessibility, Family Screen Time. On Xiaomi, also allow Autostart.
